items.title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
items.summary: OpenAI announces GPT-6 Astra, a new generation of their flagship AI model specifically designed to enhance productivity and intelligence for professional applications.

items.title: AuK Technical Report: An Open-Source Foundational Model for Speech Generation and Editing
items.summary: A new open-source foundational model, AuK, has been released for advanced speech generation and editing, demonstrating high engagement and potential for broad application.

items.title: OpenAI adds a prominent AI doomer to its board of directors
items.summary: OpenAI has appointed Paul Christiano, a prominent figure known for his focus on AI safety and potential risks, to its Foundation Board, signaling a reinforced commitment to alignment and governance.

items.title: AI research startup Listen Labs scrubbed a $1.5B funding round for Salesforce talks
items.summary: AI research startup Listen Labs reportedly cancelled a significant $1.5 billion funding round to enter acquisition discussions with Salesforce, indicating major consolidation and strategic moves in the AI industry.

items.title: Omni Interaction Agent Technical Report
items.summary: A new technical report details the Omni Interaction Agent, a novel AI agent architecture designed for versatile and complex interactions across various domains.

items.title: Eliciting Weak-to-Strong Generalization with On-Policy Reverse Distillation
items.summary: New research explores a method called On-Policy Reverse Distillation to elicit weak-to-strong generalization in AI models, a crucial step for improving alignment and safety.

items.title: I let AI write 100% of my code for 30 days. Here's what broke.
items.summary: A developer shares a candid account of attempting to use AI for 100% of their coding tasks over 30 days, highlighting practical challenges and limitations encountered.

items.title: The Verification Bottleneck in AI-Generated Software
items.summary: This article discusses the critical challenge of verifying the correctness and reliability of software code generated by AI, identifying it as a major bottleneck for widespread adoption.

items.title: Mask Forcing: Improving Autoregressive Video Diffusion Distillation via Dual-Noise Masking Rollout
items.summary: Researchers introduce Mask Forcing, a technique that uses dual-noise masking rollout to significantly improve the distillation of autoregressive video diffusion models.

items.title: Miles v0.1: Production-Level Post-Training
items.summary: Miles v0.1 is presented as a new framework for production-level post-training of AI models, aiming to streamline the deployment and refinement process.

items.title: Marigold V2: Revisiting Diffusion Transformers for Monocular Depth Estimation
items.summary: Marigold V2 revisits the use of Diffusion Transformers to achieve improved performance in monocular depth estimation, a key task in computer vision.

items.title: Show-Harness: Just a VLM Agent Can Play Robots
items.summary: This paper demonstrates that a Vision-Language Model (VLM) agent, without additional specialized training, can effectively control robots to perform tasks.

items.title: Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents
items.summary: New research introduces Procedural Graphs, a method for creating self-evolving execution structures that enhance the capabilities and adaptability of LLM agents.

items.title: TANGO: Humanoid Navigation in Cluttered Environments with a Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Model
items.summary: TANGO presents a novel whole-body Vision-Language-Action model enabling humanoid robots to navigate complex, cluttered environments more effectively.

items.title: I Hid a Rule in CLAUDE.md. Only One Reviewer Could Prove It Read It.
items.summary: An intriguing experiment reveals how a hidden rule within a markdown file was only detected by one reviewer, raising questions about the subtle capabilities and limitations of LLM comprehension.
